biggest_catch: The fetched page's step-by-step qualification language describes the referred person's own award ($25 + $50); the exact trigger for the referrer's $75 (beyond the referred member opening savings and checking) is not fully spelled out on the fetched page - the detailed terms live on share.ngfcu.us/refer.
catches: Referrer must be a current NGFCU member in good standing and at least 18 years of age.
Referred applicant must open an NGFCU savings and checking account for the referrer to be eligible for the award.
Referred person's own award: $25 after 10 debit card transactions + opting out of paper statements within 90 days; $50 after two direct deposits of at least $100 each within 90 days.
Referrer cap: maximum $750 per calendar year to a single referrer (10 referrals at $75 each).
Referral awards are distributed as deposits into the referrer's NGFCU regular share savings account and are subject to taxation.
NGFCU reserves the right to change or cancel the program at any time.
